tagline: Receive divine guidance through Quranic verse
taglineEn: Receive divine guidance through Quranic verse
religiousNote: This verse is for reflection. The Sunnah Istikhara is two rak'ahs and the dua. For major decisions, also seek counsel from people of knowledge.

home.subtitle: Calm your heart in the quiet light of the Noble Quran.

prepare.title: Prepare Your Heart
prepare.step1Body: The Sunnah Istikhara begins with wudu and praying two voluntary rak'ahs. If you cannot pray right now or simply wish to reflect on a verse, you may continue to the next step.
prepare.step2Body: Recite the Istikhara dua with sincerity. Tap the highlighted phrase to see where to mention your specific matter.
prepare.tapPhrase: Tap the highlighted phrase to see where to mention your matter
prepare.step3Body: Choose a category and optionally write a brief private note.
prepare.privacyBadge: Stored only on your device — no server, no account
prepare.notePlaceholder: Optional private note about your decision...

focus.title: Focus Moment
focus.prompt: Recite Durood Sharif and focus your heart on your matter.
focus.tasbihHint: Tap the bead 3 times or press and hold for 3 seconds

result.repeatReminder: Repeating Istikhara repeatedly for the same matter is not encouraged — place your trust in Allah (tawakkul) and consult people of wisdom (istishara).
result.errorBody: Unable to reach the Quran API. Please check your connection and try again.
result.includeNoteInPdf: Include my private note in PDF

share.title: Share Verse
share.privacyNote: Your private intention note is never included in shares.

history.title: My Verses
history.journalLabel: What did you decide? How did it turn out?
history.journalPlaceholder: Write your private reflection (stored only on your device)...
history.confirmClear: Are you sure you want to delete all recorded verses and notes?

daily.title: Verse of the Day
daily.subtitle: A shared daily Quranic verse for quiet reflection

settings.title: Settings
settings.offlineDesc: Download the full Arabic, Urdu, and English editions once for offline use.

about.title: About & Sources
about.purposeBody: Istikhara is a calm, ad-free, privacy-first web app designed to support Muslims with the Sunnah Istikhara method, dua, and quiet reflection on Quranic verses.
about.privacyBody: No accounts, no analytics, and no server database. Your intentions, history, and reflections stay strictly on your own device in localStorage and IndexedDB.

pwa.installBody: Add Istikhara to your home screen for fast, offline-ready access.
